research_topic: How is immune homeostasis maintained and regulated?

accepted_gaps.title: Static-reference problem
accepted_gaps.statement: Population averages and one-time samples inadequately represent a person's homeostatic trajectory.

accepted_gaps.title: Cross-compartment integration problem
accepted_gaps.statement: Blood, barrier, microbiota, tissue, metabolic, and history layers are not routinely aligned into an interpretable state.

accepted_gaps.title: Adaptation-versus-dysregulation problem
accepted_gaps.statement: Snapshot abnormalities cannot reliably distinguish a transient response, durable immune memory, and persistent dysregulation.

accepted_gaps.title: Human-causal-platform problem
accepted_gaps.statement: Animal and simplified systems cannot alone validate individualized human immune feedback mechanisms.

accepted_gaps.title: Rebalancing-endpoint problem
accepted_gaps.statement: Broad immune modulation lacks a validated, individual-specific endpoint for restored contextual regulation.

rejected_gaps.title: One universal immune-health score is sufficient
rejected_gaps.reason: The survey evidence supports multi-layer individual variation and compartment-specific mechanisms instead.
